spec_basis: [STU-VID-030] Nest replaces a selection with a single clip whose source is a newly created sequence containing that selection; Make subsequence creates a sequence from a selection or from the in-to-out range without replacing it; a nested sequence clip is opaque to timeline operations; re-entered by an explicit reveal command; recursive with no fixed depth limit; a cycle is a validation error
[STU-VID-030a] preserve nested frame rate / resolution: deferred (no Folio field; StudioSequence has no frame size)
[STU-VID-040] every operation is one reversible StudioHistoryEntry
STU-VID-041 command ids: cmd.clip.nestify, cmd.sequence.makesubsequence (Shift+U), cmd.sequence.makesubsequencefromintoout, cmd.tlnav.reveal.nested.sequence (Ctrl+Alt+F)
declared_readings: selection = named clips plus their whole link groups

new sequence: parent frame_rate; mirrors only the tracks holding selected clips (kind, per-kind order, name, enabled, muted, sync_locked, targeted, volume, pan; locked/soloed off); clips re-based to 0 from the selection start, floored to the frame grid when video is selected

Nest: one nested clip per kind present on the lowest-index selected track of that kind, spanning re-base point to selection end, source [0, span) unit speed, linked by the caller's group when more than one; clips move with their ids, markers and transitions; unplayable transitions pruned and listed
Make Subsequence: copies with fresh clip and record ids, link groups kept; range = targeted tracks (all when none targeted) cut at the edges; locked tracks refuse Nest only
nested video weight multiplies inner layer weights (group-opacity approximation)

nested audio = the nested sequence's plain timeline mix (not its bus routing); unrenderable nested sequence plays silent AND is reported (mixer status + mixer_json nest_reports; bus_stream export path refuses instead)

history label: op sequence.nest / sequence.make_subsequence; the session receipt provider stays multicam.step (session's only multi-sequence step reused unchanged with records passed through; not renamed in session)
notes.unverified: Premiere receiving track, track mirroring, subsequence range cut and playhead mapping on Open Nested UNVERIFIED (D5)
spec_deltas: STU-VID-030a needs an additive Folio side record (per nested sequence: preserve_frame_rate, preserve_resolution) and StudioSequence frame size; package suite in the lane that adds it (rule 4b)
no clause defines which track receives the nested clip, how tracks are mirrored, or the subsequence range cut
no clause defines how a nested clip's clip gain / pan envelopes move with it (this lane refuses nest_clip_envelopes_unsupported)

run_ui_md_lines_for_lead: Nest (lane SMB-PR-NEST-1): select a clip and press Nest in the timeline toolbar: the clip and its linked clips become one nested sequence clip (one undo step).
Make Subsequence (Shift+U) copies the selected clip, or the program monitor's in-to-out range, into a new sequence and leaves the open sequence unchanged (one undo step).
Open Nested (Ctrl+Alt+F or double-click a nested clip) shows the nested sequence in the timeline and program monitor; Back to Parent returns; the toolbar shows the nesting path.
